method: Outer stratified CV with inner model selection and separate calibration split
threshold_selection: Threshold selected on a stratified calibration subset excluded from model tuning and fitting; maximize F1 subject to recall >= 0.80 where feasible, with higher threshold as tie-break.
interpretation_warning: Smoke-test estimates only. The historical holdout has already influenced earlier model and threshold choices. This is not a new untouched holdout evaluation. Each fold fits on fewer rows because a separate calibration subset is reserved for threshold selection.
